_template_notes.purpose: Backend Database Schema graph — Discovery Plugin #12 (v2.0 Gói C++ Stage 2.2). Parse EF Core Migrations + DbContext OnModelCreating để extract tables, columns, foreign keys, indexes, unique constraints, sequences. Source: Grep EF Migration files (`*.Designer.cs` + Up()/Down() trong Migrations/) + DbContext OnModelCreating EntityTypeBuilder calls. Consumed by lane CD17 (Persistence Consistency) qua graph_dependency — phát hiện schema drift, missing FK, orphan columns.
populate: tables[]: 1 entry per CREATE TABLE từ migrations — {id, name, module, schema?, file_path, line, primary_key{columns[], constraint_name?}, columns[], indexes[], foreign_keys[], unique_constraints[]}
module: extracted from migration file path (Eureka.Modules.{Name}.Infrastructure.Persistence.Migrations)
columns[]: 1 entry per column — {name, sql_type, csharp_type?, nullable, max_length?, default_value?, is_identity?}
sql_type: PostgreSQL native types vd 'varchar(255)', 'uuid', 'jsonb', 'timestamp with time zone'
csharp_type: inferred từ AddColumn<TType>() generic argument trong Up() body (vd 'string', 'Guid', 'DateTime?')
foreign_keys[]: 1 entry per FK — {name, columns[], references_table, references_columns[], on_delete: 'Cascade|Restrict|SetNull|NoAction', on_update?}
indexes[]: 1 entry per index — {name, columns[], is_unique, filter?}
edges[]: cross-table relationships — {from_table_id, to_table_id, kind: 'fk|index_shared|inheritance', via: column_name?, on_delete?}
metadata.build_at: ISO 8601 timestamp khi graph built
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' (Grep + line-based EF Migration parser). v2.1 → `dotnet ef dbcontext info` JSON output cho full type resolution + Roslyn syntax tree for OnModelCreating analysis.
metadata.migration_count: tổng số .cs files trong */Migrations/ scanned
metadata.modules_covered: list of module short names có migrations
metadata.cumulative_view: true|false (true = aggregate qua tất cả migrations để có schema state cuối; false = chỉ list từng migration)
metadata.kinds_distribution: count per object kind cho quick overview
metadata.last_migration_per_module: {module: last_migration_name} cho schema age tracking
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/backend/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (lane CD17 sẽ fallback Grep với E134 WARN)
Tech stack backend != .NET → SKIP, log E137 WARN (parser chỉ support EF Core C# migrations)
Không tìm thấy */Migrations/ subdir trong any apps/backend/* → SKIP, log E137 WARN (project có thể dùng raw SQL hoặc Dapper)
Không parse được bất kỳ CREATE TABLE nào → write tables=[] với skipped:false + WARN E139 (downstream lane Grep fallback)
